svg.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: Your LinkedIn network, turned into a to-do list. Safely.
LinkedIn has to give you your own data. This skill fetches it, reads it on your laptop and shows you what to do.
Why this is safe, and most LinkedIn automation is not
Bots that act as you: avoid
Risk: an account most people value at $100k+
This skill: reads your own file
✓ A feature LinkedIn must offer you
✓ 2 clicks on a settings page, in your own browser
✓ Stops at any password, code or captcha
Never sends an invite, message, like or comment
